data.name: Cricket Champions
data.detailed_description:
Cricket Champions is a competitive cricket simulation currently in development by Zadventure Games Inc.

Designed for everyone who loves cricket and thrives on its intensity, pressure, and unforgettable moments, Cricket Champions delivers an experience built around skill, timing, and match awareness. Whether it’s a perfectly timed cover drive or a game-changing delivery, every moment is driven by player input and decision-making.

The game features both online PvP competition and a deep single-player journey. Our career mode is designed to offer a cricket experience unlike anything seen before in the genre, giving players a long-form path to grow, compete, and master the sport.

Built on authentic, physics-based gameplay, Cricket Champions gives full control over batting, bowling, and fielding, ensuring every action feels responsive and grounded in real cricket mechanics. From ball movement to player animations, everything is designed to reflect realistic, skill-based gameplay.

Cricket Champions is currently in development. The footage shown may include pre-alpha, in-engine gameplay, and all visuals, features, and systems are subject to ongoing refinement as development progresses.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Requirements may change as the game continues development.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended for smoother loading and performance. Final requirements may change before release.
